C1707.title: Discussion of Defender for Cloud Apps Domain Allowlist False Positives
C1707.summary: In August 2023, an organization posted in a community forum about a false positive issue involving Azure AD domain allowlists and Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps integration: after configuring an allowlist so only authorized domains could access shared files, some file sharing still triggered unauthorized domain policy alerts, creating unnecessary alert and response workload. The poster sought possible causes and solutions in the community; the current references do not show sensitive data leakage.
